jd: We're hiring a Backend Engineer to build payment services in Python and Go (Golang). You'll design RESTful APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis, deploy with Docker on AWS and ship through CI/CD. Nice to have: Kubernetes, Kafka.
Frontend Developer. Build accessible UIs with React and TypeScript, state in Redux, styling with Tailwind and CSS. You'll write unit tests with Jest. Bonus points for Next.js experience.

Graduate Software Engineer. Strong fundamentals in data structures and algorithms and object-oriented programming in Java or C++. Familiarity with Git and Linux. Go to our careers site to see our values. The rest of the process is two interviews.
ML Engineer: train and deploy deep learning models with PyTorch, build data pipelines in Spark and Airflow, and serve LLMs in production on GCP. Experience with NLP is a plus.
Full-stack (MERN) developer: MongoDB, Express.js, React and Node.js. Build real-time features with WebSockets. Preferred: experience with Docker and AWS.
Mobile Engineer working on our Android app in Kotlin and our iOS app in Swift. Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs. Would be a plus: React Native.
Data Analyst. Use SQL, Python (pandas, NumPy) and Tableau or Power BI to turn data into insights for stakeholders. Strong Excel skills and communication.
Platform Engineer. Own our Kubernetes clusters on Azure, write infrastructure as code with Terraform, and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines. Scripting in Bash and Python.
Game Developer: build gameplay systems in C++ with Unreal Engine 5. Knowledge of multiplayer networking is desirable. We work in an agile, two-week sprint process.

Software Engineer, Search. Build distributed systems and microservices in Java with Spring Boot, using Elasticsearch and Kafka. System design interviews included. Experience with gRPC is good to have.
Customer-facing Solutions Engineer. You'll rest easy knowing our team supports you. Help clients integrate our JS SDK and REST APIs; occasional Python scripting. Travel within Europe.
Computer Vision Engineer: build detection models with PyTorch and OpenCV, optimise inference in C++, and run experiments on AWS. Publications are a plus.
